study type: Observational, analytical, ambispective cohort study with longitudinal follow-up
cohort: 1295 pregnant women with SARS-CoV2 infection from 78 hospitals in Spain
finding: Patients developing COVID-19 during the first wave had more symptoms at triage, early pregnancy, greater rates of COVID-19-related maternal morbidity, caesarean section, and preterm birth compared to those infected during the second wave.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in the first wave compared to the second wave.
